name: karaoke-captions
title: Karaoke Captions
description: A caption line that fills word by word as it is spoken — heavy outlined type that reads on any footage. Three presets: karaoke, highlight (the word rides an accent bar), clean.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/captions/karaoke-captions?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
